[0] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[1] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[2] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[3] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[4] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[5] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[6] G6PD overexpression in female mice improved their resistance to oxidative stress, protected them from aging-associated decline, and increased their lifespan.

[7] G6PD overexpression in male mice improved their resistance to oxidative stress and protected them from aging-associated decline, but didn't affect their lifespan.

[8] Neuronal overexpression of GCLc (Appl-GAL4 and D42-GAL4 neuronal drivers) in a long-lived background extended mean and maximum life spans up to 50%, without affecting the rate of oxygen consumption by the flies. Positive effects were also observed with the elav-GAL4 driver, but these effects were consistently significant (p < 0.05) only for the elav/GCLc5 genotype.

[9] Overexpression of GCLc using the mushroom body driver (OK107-GAL4) had a small but significant beneficial effect on longevity (approximately 12%) while overexpression in serotonergic (MZ360-GAL4) neurons or dopaminergic and serotonergic neurons (Ddc-GAL4) had small, nonsignificant effects on longevity.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
